_comment: Cloudflare Access policy — gabriel.noizy.ai restricted to RSP_001 only. This is a config artifact; apply via Cloudflare dashboard or API (see .sh file in same dir). Do NOT commit account_id or api_token to git.

service_tokens._comment: Optional: machine-to-machine token for GABRIEL daemon → gabriel.noizy.ai. Store the client_secret in wrangler secret as GABRIEL_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET. Never commit.
service_tokens.name: gabriel-daemon

notes.identity_providers: Requires at minimum a one-time-pin (OTP) email IdP. Recommended: add GitHub IdP for RSPNOIZY handle as second option.
notes.mfa_requirement: MFA is enforced at the policy level — RSP must complete TOTP or WebAuthn on every new device.
notes.kill_switch_integration: If HEAVEN Kill Switch fires for RSP_001, this Access app MUST be disabled via API within 30s. Hook to be built: Heaven /kill endpoint → Cloudflare API DELETE on app UUID.
notes.audit: Cloudflare Access logs → Logpush to R2 bucket `gabriel-access-audit` for 100-year retention per Estate doctrine.
